title: course home link/3
description: The payload a course home link carries (#c2 or #c3 and then the deflated or raw base64url JSON; c1, which a 2.0.0 course home wrote, is read by migrating it): a course package, at the lowest version that carries it, so c3 only for a package that needs /3 (a collection, a term or outcomes) and c2 for every other course. The prefix is the package's version and is not in the payload. js/course/links.js readCourseFragment() returns the payload and refuses a wrong kind, a newer prefix (`newerVersion`) and a corrupt one; the package is then validated by the course validator, which gravitas.course-pack/2 and /3 describe in full, so only the part that makes a payload a course package is stated here. FORMATS.md lists it.
